complete_mechanism_diagnosis: Valid amortization and causal/cost bookkeeping do not resolve same-bank selection optimism, stale update-direction limitations, or the empirically inactive receipt resource price. Both tasks learn under strong references; this is not rescued by removing the one-percent margin.
bounded_design_judgment: Reject widening this receipt-only PPO-ray selector. A substantive successor would have to change the actual joint-version/off-policy-corrected update program under a joint-policy trust constraint, not merely add the already-compared KL ray cap. Resource actions must have avoidable prospective cost. This is an unvalidated research requirement, not a proved novel method or promised positive result.
